app.title: Rinde
app.tagline: Does my salary last the month?
app.intro: Your accounts, installments and dollars in one place.

health.heading: System status
health.ok: The API and the database are up.
health.unavailable: The API responds, but the database is unavailable.

brand.label: About Rinde
brand.privacy: No email and no personal data: just a username.
brand.security: Passwords handled the way NIST recommends.
brand.currencies: Pesos, dollars and installments in one place.
brand.footnote: Each square is a day of the month: aqua ones are covered by your salary.

fields.usernameHelp: 3 to 30 characters: letters, numbers, dot, hyphen or underscore.
fields.passwordHelp: {{length}} of at least {{min}} characters. A phrase is safer and easier to remember: “my cat eats noodles on tuesdays”.
fields.recoveryCodeHelp: 20 letters and numbers. You can type it with or without hyphens.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: No email and no personal data: just a username and a phrase you remember.

recover.title: Recover your account
recover.subtitle: With the code you saved when you created it. You will choose a new password and every open session will be closed.

code.explain: It is the only way to recover your account if you forget your password. We will not show it again.
code.rotatedNote: Your previous code no longer works.
code.label: Your recovery code
code.copyFailed: Could not copy it. Select the code and copy it manually.
code.confirm: I saved the code somewhere safe

session.waking: Waking up the server: the first visit of the day can take up to a minute.

errors.USERNAME_INVALID: Use 3 to 30 characters: letters, numbers, dot, hyphen or underscore, no spaces.
errors.USERNAME_RESERVED: That name is reserved. Choose another one.
errors.USERNAME_TAKEN: That name is already taken. Try another one.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: It must be at least 15 characters long. Try a phrase.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: It can be up to 128 characters long.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SIMPLE: It is too repetitive. Use a phrase with different words.
errors.PASSWORD_COMPROMISED: That password appeared in data breaches from other sites. Choose another one.
errors.RECOVERY_CODE_INVALID: The username or the recovery code is not correct.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The username or the password is not correct.
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many failed attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.NOT_AUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.CSRF_REJECTED: We could not validate the request. Reload the page and try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: No connection to Rinde. Check your internet and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
